title: Record phase g gui components verification
description:
Write docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md only. Record that phase g GUI components (SpectrumVisualizer and MeterComponent) were implemented and verified with the plan's CMake/Ninja Standalone stack plus cppcheck and clang-format — not make.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h
- Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp
- Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h
- Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp
- docs/verification/ (prior phase verification notes if present)

Document must include:
- Phase id g and goal summary (FFT SpectrumVisualizer + L/R MeterComponent)
- Changed files list matching the four GUI sources
- Verification commands actually required:
  - cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja
  - cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone
  - cppcheck --enable=all Source/
  - clang-format --dry-run --Werror on Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp
- Real-time safety notes: Timer capped 30-60 Hz; FIFO/atomics consume on message thread only; no audio-thread repaint; no audio-thread heap/locks; FFT/FIFO sizes match processor phase e
- Explicit statement that make was not used as the build verifier
- Pass/fail checklist placeholders or recorded results for build, cppcheck, and clang-format

Do not modify any Source/ files in this task.
acceptance_criteria: docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md records cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja and cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone
docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md records cppcheck --enable=all Source/ and clang-format --dry-run --Werror on the four GUI files
docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md states make is not the phase verifier
docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md notes Timer-capped 30-60 Hz message-thread FIFO/atomics consume and no audio-thread repaint
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change any C++ source or header

allowed: write phase g verification markdown summarizing build and RT-safety checks
forbidden: claim VST3/CLAP/LV2 full matrix build as this phase gate
use make as the recorded build command
